size_note: July16 disclosure approximately 9.6% issuer economic exposure, later 12.9%; neither is fund NAV. Approximately US$2bn dedicated PS IV capital is distinct from diversified funds and not an initial April trade weight.

drivers.driver: High-quality differentiated retailer believed undervalued relative to durable business value.
drivers.quote: there has been no meaningful diminution in the per-share value of Target since our initial purchase 18 months ago.

drivers.driver: Credit-card receivables monetization and buybacks could release capital and improve shareholder returns.
Owned land/real estate offered structural value not separately recognized; specific REIT/ground-lease plan developed later and must not be backdated to initial entry.
Independent retail, property and capital-allocation expertise on the board could implement changes.

entry_valuation_stated: Q3 2008 letter retrospectively describes initial mid/high-US$50s purchases. April20 close US$62.12 is only the frozen market observation, not claimed weighted cost. Specific future land-price target excluded from docs.
outcome_note: Dedicated leveraged/option-heavy PS IV reportedly lost approximately 90% by early2009; this is a dated dedicated-vehicle drawdown, not audited lifetime P&L on all manager-wide Target common shares. February8 2009 letter apologized and offered redemption/fee concessions. Credit-card interest was partially monetized; proposed land REIT did not occur and 2009 five-nominee proxy slate lost. Final common shares sold Q1 2011. Lesson: franchise quality/asset value do not protect a concentrated time-sensitive instrument from catalyst failure and severe drawdown.
pack_quality_notes: Eight pre-cutoff documents. Primary 2006 annual financials, property table and card contribution, April11 sales, latest actually available 13F, three peers and opposing earnings commentary. Explicit no-double-counting treatment. Firm AUM, actual April execution day/NAV weight, independent property appraisal, complete market consensus/multiples and original entry quotations remain gaps. Later plan and PS IV vehicle confined to key.
